question: What is the average lap time in milliseconds of all the lap records set on the various circuits in Italy?
clarification: Count each distinct lap only once.
gold: SELECT CAST(SUM(T1.milliseconds) AS REAL) / COUNT(DISTINCT T1.lap) FROM lapTimes AS T1 INNER JOIN races AS T2 ON T1.raceId = T2.raceId INNER JOIN circuits AS T3 ON T2.circuitId = T3.circuitId WHERE T3.country = 'Italy'
gold0: SELECT CAST(SUM(T1.milliseconds) AS REAL) / COUNT(T1.lap) FROM lapTimes AS T1 INNER JOIN races AS T2 on T1.raceId = T2.raceId INNER JOIN circuits AS T3 on T2.circuitId = T3.circuitId WHERE T3.country = 'Italy'

d.request: What is the average lap time in milliseconds of lap records set on circuits in Italy, counting each distinct lap only once?
d.sql: SELECT AVG(lap.milliseconds) AS average_lap_time_ms FROM (SELECT DISTINCT lt.raceId, lt.driverId, lt.lap, lt.milliseconds FROM lapTimes AS lt JOIN races AS r ON r.raceId = lt.raceId JOIN circuits AS c ON c.circuitId = r.circuitId WHERE c.country = 'Italy') AS lap

b.request: Average `lapTimes.milliseconds` for laps in races held at circuits in Italy, counting each distinct `(raceId, driverId, lap)` once
b.sql: SELECT AVG(lt.milliseconds) AS average_milliseconds FROM (SELECT raceId, driverId, lap, MAX(milliseconds) AS milliseconds FROM lapTimes GROUP BY raceId, driverId, lap) AS lt JOIN races AS r ON r.raceId = lt.raceId JOIN circuits AS c ON c.circuitId = r.circuitId WHERE c.country = 'Italy'

c.request:
What is the average lap time in milliseconds of all the lap records set on the various circuits in Italy?
Evidence: average = AVG(milliseconds)
Count each distinct lap only once.
c.sql: SELECT AVG(milliseconds) AS average_lap_time_ms FROM (SELECT DISTINCT lt.raceId, lt.driverId, lt.lap, lt.milliseconds FROM lapTimes AS lt JOIN races AS r ON r.raceId = lt.raceId JOIN circuits AS c ON c.circuitId = r.circuitId WHERE c.country = 'Italy') AS distinct_laps
